title: bomify plugin SupportedComponentsResult
description: The single JSON object a bomify-plugin-<type> binary must print to stdout on success for its "security supported-components" subcommand, per plugins/contracts/security/v1/CONTRACT.md. Validate a plugin's actual stdout output (one line, one object) against this schema to check it for structural conformance.

types.description: Every component purl type (e.g. "oci", "helm", "npm", "generic") this plugin knows how to scan, mapped to how it scans it: "purl" from the purl alone, or "files" only from the component's pulled files, passed as "security scan --input". A component whose purl type isn't in this map is never sent to "security scan".

scans.description: The categories of scan this plugin performs, e.g. "sca", "sast". Purely informational today — bomify logs it, but doesn't yet act on it.
